title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.00 (quiet) at 00:00 UTC on 23 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 23 日 00:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.00 (0Z) at 00:00 UTC on 23 September. The 00:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 00:59; hour-start 0.00/0Z, hour-end 0.33/0P). The trailing 01:00 UTC hour is incomplete (18 samples through 01:17) and is not used as the headline hour. Last-180 maximum is 0.67 (first at 2026-09-22 23:00 UTC; label 1M; last-180 window from 22:18 UTC). Published-window maximum is 0.67 (first at 2026-09-22 20:27 UTC; label 1M). Window start 2026-09-22 19:20 UTC (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.
summary.zh: 最後可靠整點估計 Kp 為 0.00（0Z），取樣 2026-09-23 00:00 UTC。00:00 時段已收滿 60 筆（至 00:59，時段初 0.00／0Z、時段末 0.33／0P）。01:00 UTC 時段尚未收滿（18 筆至 01:17），不作為主卡片整點。近 180 筆最大 0.67（最先見於 2026-09-22 23:00 UTC；標籤 1M；近 180 筆窗自 22:18 UTC 起）；公開窗最大 0.67（最先見於 2026-09-22 20:27 UTC；標籤 1M）。窗起點 2026-09-22 19:20 UTC（358 筆）。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of a completed hour that is not a trailing incomplete placeholder (00:00 UTC on 23 September). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 00:00 UTC is 0.00/0Z; the hour ends 0.33/0P at 00:59. The incomplete 01:00 hour is excluded from the headline. A 0.67/1M excursion remains in the published window (first at 2026-09-22 20:27 UTC).
